saturn.1: First Saturn square, around age 7. Saturn has gone a quarter of the way around since your birth. Rules, grades, chores and being compared with other children press on you for the first time, and you learn what you can and cannot do yet. Habits of effort, and of self-doubt, start to form here.
saturn.2: Saturn opposition, around age 14 or 15. Saturn is halfway around and directly opposite its birth position. Independence runs into limits at home and school, and you start to see yourself through how others judge you. What you are told to be is weighed against what you want to be.
saturn.3: Second Saturn square, around age 22. School is ending or over and adult responsibility begins: work, money, a place of your own. Early choices start to carry a cost, and you build the first structure you will have to live in.
saturn.4: First Saturn return, around age 29. Saturn is back where it stood at your birth. This is the first full review of your adult life. The career, relationships and habits you built since leaving home are measured against what suits you. What you took on from others is dropped, and what you will own for the next thirty years is committed to.
saturn.5: Saturn square, around age 37. This is the first quarter of your second Saturn cycle. The structure you committed to at the return meets heavy demands: a career climb, children, ageing parents, money. Where you over-built or under-built shows.
saturn.6: Saturn opposition, around age 44. The midpoint of your second Saturn cycle. What you have built is seen from across the table. Some people change course and others tighten what works. Energy, health and who you answer to come up for review.
saturn.7: Saturn square, around age 51. The last quarter before your second return. Children leave, a career peak passes and roles shift. You decide what you will carry into the next stage and what you will put down.
saturn.8: Second Saturn return, around age 58 or 59. A second full cycle ends. The question is what the rest of your life will be built on. Retirement, a change of work, and caring for others or being cared for come up. What no longer fits is let go, and a quieter, more selective structure takes its place.
saturn.9: Saturn square, around age 66. The start of a third cycle. Routines after work are rebuilt, health becomes something you manage, and the circle of people who matter gets smaller and firmer.
saturn.10: Saturn opposition, around age 73. The midpoint of the third cycle. What you have kept up for decades is weighed against your energy. Independence, where you live and how you spend your days are reconsidered.
saturn.11: Saturn square, around age 80. You simplify. Health and help from others become practical matters, and what you pass on, by teaching or by arrangement, comes into focus.
saturn.12: Third Saturn return, around age 88. A third full cycle ends, which few people reach. The review is about what has lasted and what is still yours to do, with attention on the days themselves and not on long plans.
saturn.13: Saturn square, around age 95. A very small, steady structure of daily routine and trusted people carries the load.
saturn.14: Saturn opposition, around age 103. Strength is measured in what you still do on your own terms.
saturn.15: Saturn square, around age 110. Life narrows to what matters most each day.
saturn.16: Fourth Saturn return, around age 117 or 118. A fourth full cycle closes.

jupiter.1: First Jupiter return, around age 12. Jupiter is back where it stood at your birth after about twelve years. A cycle of growth begins as childhood ends: curiosity widens, and new skills, friends and ideas start to shape what you aim for.
jupiter.2: Second Jupiter return, around age 24. A chance to expand in adult life opens: study, first full-time work, travel, a move. What you commit to now sets the direction of the next twelve years.
jupiter.3: Third Jupiter return, around age 36. A new twelve-year growth cycle opens just as Saturn's second cycle begins to press. Work, family or the place you live can widen. Taking a chance on something larger is easier now, before the heavier demands of your late thirties set in.
jupiter.4: Fourth Jupiter return, around age 48. Opportunity tends to come through experience: a bigger role, a teaching or mentoring position, a change that uses what you have learned.
jupiter.5: Fifth Jupiter return, around age 60. Growth turns toward what you want to do beyond work: learning, travel, time with family, or a second career.
jupiter.6: Sixth Jupiter return, around age 72. A cycle of growth through meaning: what you teach, tell or leave behind widens your reach.
jupiter.7: Seventh Jupiter return, around age 84. Optimism returns in small, practical ways: contact with family, new interests, gratitude for what has lasted.
jupiter.8: Eighth Jupiter return, around age 96. A quiet widening of attention to people and moments.
jupiter.9: Ninth Jupiter return, around age 108. A rare milestone that opens a further cycle.
jupiter.10: Tenth Jupiter return, around age 120. A tenth twelve-year cycle begins.

uranus.1: First Uranus square, around age 21. Uranus has gone a quarter of the way around from its birth position. You push against the family pattern and the way you were raised. You try freedom, move, change direction or break from a path set for you.
uranus.2: Uranus opposition, around age 42. Uranus is halfway around and opposite its birth position. This is the midlife shake-up. The life you built is questioned, and the pull to change whatever no longer fits grows strong. Changes of career, relationship or home are common now.
uranus.3: Second Uranus square, around age 63. A break from the identity you built through work. Retirement, relocation or a new pursuit comes up, and you ask what freedom means now.
uranus.4: Uranus return, around age 84. Uranus completes a full circle in one lifetime. You see what has stayed true to you from the start, and you drop the roles that were never yours.
uranus.5: Uranus square, around age 105. A restless urge for change reaches a very advanced age.

neptune.1: Neptune square, around age 41. The ideals your life was built around are tested against what has happened. Faith, vision and dreams are checked, and disillusion clears space for a more honest sense of what you believe in. Direction can feel unclear until it does.
neptune.2: Neptune opposition, around age 82. What you have believed and loved is seen from a distance. Acceptance and letting go replace striving, and the line between yourself and the world softens.

pluto.1: Pluto square. Pluto reaches a quarter of the way around from its birth position. Control, power and what you will not give up are tested, and something you hold onto is stripped away. You come out more certain of what you value. The age depends on how fast your natal Pluto moves, and varies a great deal between people.
pluto.2: Pluto opposition. Pluto reaches the point opposite its birth position, which happens late in life or not at all within one lifetime. Power and endings are seen from the other side, and what is left is what matters.

northnode.2: North Node opposition, around age 9. The Nodes are halfway through their return cycle. You pull toward what is familiar and then toward what is new. A first sense of what you are drawn to grows, and early talents show.
northnode.4: First North Node return, around age 18 or 19. The Nodes are back where they stood at your birth. Direction resets as you leave home. Questions about purpose and what you are growing toward come up for the first time, and the choices you make now set a path for the next nineteen years.
northnode.6: North Node opposition, around age 28. Halfway through your second nodal cycle. You see what you have grown toward and what you have left behind, and you adjust whether the life you chose still points where you want to go.
northnode.8: Second North Node return, around age 37. Direction resets again. The commitments you made in your twenties are reviewed against what pulls you now, and a change of work or direction is common.
northnode.10: North Node opposition, around age 47. A midlife look at where you have been heading. What you have avoided comes into view, and you decide whether to turn toward it.
northnode.12: Third North Node return, around age 56. Another reset: your later working years and what you want to be known for.
northnode.14: North Node opposition, around age 65. A look at what you have left undone and what you want to finish.
northnode.16: Fourth North Node return, around age 74 or 75. Direction resets around what you want your later life to say.
northnode.18: North Node opposition, around age 84. What you want to leave and complete becomes the question.
northnode.20: Fifth North Node return, around age 93. A rare reset of direction.
northnode.22: North Node opposition, around age 103. A rare half-cycle.
northnode.24: Sixth North Node return, around age 112. A rare reset of direction.

saturn.Aries: Saturn in Aries: limits arrive as tests of independence. You are asked to act on your own, and rushed starts get checked.
saturn.Taurus: Saturn in Taurus: money, possessions, the body and what you can rely on are examined and rebuilt slowly.
saturn.Gemini: Saturn in Gemini: learning, speaking, writing and short-distance dealings are put under discipline.
saturn.Cancer: Saturn in Cancer: home, family and emotional security carry weight, and you are asked to build safety yourself.
saturn.Leo: Saturn in Leo: self-expression, creativity and recognition are tested, and attention has to be earned.
saturn.Virgo: Saturn in Virgo: work, health and daily routine are scrutinised, and a better system is built piece by piece.
saturn.Libra: Saturn in Libra: partnerships, contracts and fairness are weighed, and commitments are held to account.
saturn.Scorpio: Saturn in Scorpio: shared money, trust and what is kept hidden are tested, and some ties are cut or rebuilt.
saturn.Sagittarius: Saturn in Sagittarius: beliefs, study, travel and long-term plans are checked against experience.
saturn.Capricorn: Saturn in Capricorn: career, status and long-term structure are weighed, and what holds up is built on.
saturn.Aquarius: Saturn in Aquarius: groups, friendships and your place in the wider world are put under discipline.
saturn.Pisces: Saturn in Pisces: boundaries, rest and what you believe in are tested, and vague plans are made concrete.
